item.title: Sign in wrong location and Road name incorrect for this section of riad, 5th August
item.description:
The road name is at the beginning of Crickley Hill Road, and it should be further up the road at the beginning of the single track by the emergency gates, which is the beginning of Dog Lane. The road that used to be the old A417 pre 1990s to Cirencester is Infact called Crickley Hill or Crickley Hill Road on some maps. This has been the case ever since the new road was built. It causes confusion for deliveries and businesses as addresses are different to the road name installed some time ago. This has been emailed, letters sent etc but as of yet the correct signeage still needs to be installed. Even if it states ‘Crickley Hill Road’ leading to ‘Dog Lane’, but it is definately NOT Dog Lane.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Dog Lane, Badgeworth, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Goldsmith Road /Cheltenham Road East, 5th August
item.description:
Another near miss at cycle path , Range Rover/ Discovery and cyclist (in hi vis ) ,inches from serious injury/ death ,the Range Rover was speeding ,well above the 30 mph limit (no 30 mph signs on Pirton Fields estate) . A PTZ. Dome camera is mounted on lamp standard No 10 directly opposite this junction ? is this camera being used correctly to monitor this area. I have enquired at many of the local agencies ,ie local councillors , GCC employees and the Police Crime Commissioner , Alas no reply’s to requests for information , or no one takes cycle path /foot path safety seriously ????.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cheltenham Road East, Churchdown, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet
